description: Read a whole conversation: every message in the thread, oldest first, each with the same fields as read_email (headers, plain-text body, attachment list). Use it when the reply history matters, such as before answering or summarising a back-and-forth; use read_email for a single message. max_chars is shared across the thread: each message gets an equal part of it (at least 2,000 characters), and longer bodies are cut and marked "[truncated]". An unknown thread_id returns an error. Read-only.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

max_chars.description: Total characters for all bodies together (default 40,000), split evenly between the messages.

thread_id.description: The "threadId" returned by search_emails or read_email.

name: read_thread
title: Read a conversation
